name: mokka
description: Mokka (Fall from Heaven), a small youth with pale icy-blue skin, big blue eyes and spiky white hair, a blue hooded parka with thick cream fur trim on the hood, cuffs and hem and dark toggle fastenings, a brown belt pouch, blue trousers, cream fur leg wraps and brown boots, a tall staff of jagged pale-blue ice crystal held upright in his RIGHT hand with its foot on the ground, and a small wooden cross-shaped totem held up in his LEFT hand
hands: the ice-crystal staff stays upright in his right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand on the screen-right side holds up the small wooden cross totem

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, the fur-trimmed hood jolting back, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the staff arm thrown up and out to the left with the ice-crystal staff, the left hand flung out to the right still holding the small wooden cross totem)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the ice-crystal staff tilting back, the left hand with the wooden totem still held out
flinch.2: recovering: halfway back to the ready pose, the ice-crystal staff coming back upright in his right hand

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up holding the ice-crystal staff high, the left hand with the wooden totem drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the hooded head droops, the ice-crystal staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the ice-crystal staff slanting down with its crystal head resting on the ground at the lower-right, the left arm hanging with the wooden totem
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the ice-crystal staff slips out of the hand and the wooden totem drops, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the fur-trimmed hood around his head; the ice-crystal staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the small wooden cross totem lies beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the fur-trimmed hood settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the ice-crystal staff and the wooden totem on the ground beside him
